facts_data.label: Drink bottle

The canteen is full; is clear; is capped; is not cold.
Should it be sent to the Cedar queue or the Birch queue?
Answer:

lines: Cold bottle items are routed to Cedar queue; all others go to Birch queue regardless of other properties.
Flask routing: Cedar when cold, Birch otherwise.
The Cedar queue receives vial items that are cold. Non-cold vial items are sent to Birch.
